fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck/dock yard is enclosed by a block wall plus chain-link fence; a curving paved entrance driveway leads through a gated opening at the SW. Controlled entry confirmed in satellite + Street View.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth observed beside the gate; entry appears gate-only (kiosk/call-box style) — set remoteGs true. Flagged as uncertain since the curving driveway corner is partly tree-shaded.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock bank along the building's south face with trailers backed in; ~24 doors estimated overhead.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large unpaved/graded trailer drop lot directly south of the building holds many dozens of trailers in rows — clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC plus a smaller secondary structure to the west/north on the same parcel.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide curving gate apron and ample paved width at the entrance leave room for an express/bypass lane.
